key_semantics.expected: The status the proof actually has when `go test ./...` runs at this tip commit. 'green' means the test passes, 'red' means it fails.
key_semantics.honest: True when the test really calls the code and really asserts on the result, so its status means what it says. False for a planted stub.
key_semantics.style: Null for every honest test. Repo A plants no stubs, so every entry here is null.
key_semantics.where: For a red proof, the file and line of the assertion that fires first. For a green proof, the file and line of the test function declaration.
key_semantics.plan_expectation_note: Where the plan's expectation and the actual status differ, the note says so. See the wrinkle.
